title: Racialization and Ethnicity
description: Examines theory and research in the area of ethnic and race relations. Topics include French-English dualism, demography of ethnic and racial groups, ethnic and racial inequality, international migration, identity and multiculturalism, racism, Indigenous and settler relations, gender and racialization, feminist critique of race and ethnic conflict.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of SOCI 235, SOCI 335.
